app_info.subtitle: Interactive contact in chat
app_info.description: JM Inline Contact renders a touch-driven interactive contact surface inside ChatGPT so users can verify that input produces visible state, consequence, and trace. The current v0.1 public body is a non-sensitive contact probe and contains no private or frozen game donor content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Renders the existing interactive probe resource and returns a receipt without modifying server-side or external data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish, send, or mutate data in any external third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or perform any irreversible action.

test_cases.description: Render the basic JM inline contact surface.
test_cases.user_prompt: Render the JM inline contact probe here.
test_cases.expected_output: Shows the interactive JM contact surface in the conversation with a touch field and visible contact state.

test_cases.description: Request a touchable in-chat contact test.
test_cases.user_prompt: Give me a touchable JM contact test inside the chat.
test_cases.expected_output: Renders the probe inline so the user can touch or drag in the field and observe visible state changes.

test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the JM probe where touching the field creates a visible Ding.
test_cases.expected_output: Renders the probe with its contact field, contact counter, Ding state, and visible trace receipt.

test_cases.user_prompt: Open the JM inline probe so I can drag the orb around.
test_cases.expected_output: Renders the interactive surface containing the draggable contact orb and state display.

test_cases.description: Repeat the contact probe without changing external state.
test_cases.user_prompt: Run the JM inline contact probe again.
test_cases.expected_output: Renders a fresh instance of the same non-sensitive inline contact probe.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for downloadable-file creation.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Create a downloadable HTML game file for me.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because its current function is inline contact rendering, not downloadable file creation.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated web information.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because weather information is outside the inline contact workflow.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for repository inspection.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Search my GitHub repository for open issues.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because repository search is outside the probe's supported workflow.
